name: Priority and Fairness
description: Tasks have priorities. The scheduler ensures fairness: no starvation, bounded waiting time for low-priority tasks.
purpose: Guarantee fair task execution across all priority levels while still respecting priority ordering for high-urgency work.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks carry a numeric priority value that the scheduler respects
No task starves indefinitely — bounded waiting time guarantees are proven and enforced
Higher-priority tasks are dispatched before lower-priority ones, subject to fairness bounds
Fairness policy prevents priority inversion and cascade blocking
Configurable aging mechanism promotes waiting tasks
Fairness metrics are exposed for monitoring and alerting
